name: Barbell Pullover
how_to:
1. Lie on a flat bench, holding the barbell over your chest with a slight bend in your elbows.
2. Inhale deeply, brace your core, and lower the barbell in an arc behind your head, keeping arms mostly straight.
3. Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your lats and chest—avoid going too far if shoulder mobility is limited.
4. Exhale and pull the barbell back over your chest using your chest and lats.
5. Control the movement throughout, especially when returning to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of reps.
